title.narrative: Empowering Startups and Building a Future-Ready Workforce for Economic Growth

description.narrative: This two-year project is designed to drive sustainable growth and innovation in Sri Lanka's tech sector, focusing on Capacity Building, Encouraging Entrepreneurship and Knowledge Exchange, and Increasing Visibility on AI and Technology Awareness. These themes aim to build skills, foster innovation, and enhance Sri Lanka’s global tech competitiveness. The purpose of this project is to address key industry challenges by closing the skill gap through specialized training, enhancing academic curricula with immersive educator programs, and promoting tech careers via regional outreach for startups and SMEs by focusing on the following key 3 areas: Capacity Building, Encouraging Entrepreneurship and knowledge exchange and Increase visibility on AI and awareness. The project is working towards empowering women, ensuring that they are more digitally aware, and running programs for women entrepreneurs.
